title: New Moon in Taurus
tldr: A seed point for value, steadiness, embodiment, money, and what is worth protecting.
theme: Taurus is a fixed earth sign ruled traditionally by Venus. This New Moon begins work around value, steadiness, embodiment, money, and what is worth protecting.
shadow: staying in stale situations because they are comfortable, or mistaking possession for security
integration: building stability that can hold change instead of resisting it

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc exposes where accepting less has been disguised as patience.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Taurus; watch what the Scorpio Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Venus kamea, green or white candle, rose quartz, copper, peridot, roses, water, and incense.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Taurus. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through value, steadiness, embodiment, money, and what is worth protecting, without repeating the shadow of staying in stale situations because they are comfortable, or mistaking possession for security?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Taurus intention take form?
